hints.title: Greedy Lake Drying
hints.text: When dry days occur, save them until an already full lake is about to be flooded again.

hints.title: Ordered Dry Days
hints.text: Keep track of indices of sunny days in an ordered collection or sorted list.

hints.title: Binary Search Earliest Valid Dry Day
hints.text: When lake L rains again after previous rain at day prev_day, binary search the earliest dry day strictly greater than prev_day.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of days in rains
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Drying a lake arbitrarily on sunny days before knowing future rains causes inevitable floods.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing sunny days and binary searching the earliest valid day after previous rain takes O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses greedy assignment with ordered set or binary search to dry the earliest needed lake.
complexity.notes: Returns empty array if flood cannot be avoided.
